rubric_items.reason: Components sit on existing api, db and web modules and follow the layering, with a new migration file. The in-process timer was decided by A-08 and its mismatch with the architecture is recorded. CO-11 is the companion glossary, as A-10 decided.
Every story is mapped, and S-7 now targets the glossary the inputs use (F-1 resolved). S-1 AC1 is still met up to an hour late under the hourly sweep, and the Stale badge has no style.

Endpoint fields have type, nullability, format and example. history[].event is still a plain string, the STALE event's fromStartsAt/toStartsAt/note are not given, and how server.ts gets a service and clock is not stated.
Code claims are cited and check out. CO-11 and the timer choices are decided by cited IDE answers A-08, A-09 and A-10, each with a recorded mismatch. Nothing is guessed.
Trade-off lines cover timer placement, running at start, hourly interval, overlap constraints, no interval env setting, and glossary-only with the PRD left at four statuses.
Clear and consistent. The front matter, components list, stories-served line and answers section agree.
